subject: Credit note for invoice INV-2526-01416
body:
Dear Unity Motors Ltd team,

We have reviewed invoice INV-2526-01416 dated 24 Sep 2025 and found that HSN 2106 was taxed at 12 percent instead of the applicable 5 percent. Accordingly, we will issue a credit note for Rs 2,681 and send a corrected invoice. Please adjust your records.
